scope: EXTERNAL_SYNTHETIC_RESEARCH_ONLY; no native training, owners, accepted refs, scheduler, controller, queue, first use, merge, deployment
hypothesis: A persisted learned hypothesis-memory state that discovers regime identity from limited witnessed intervention consequences without explicit episode IDs can preserve historical causal readouts under interference. A support-consensus update rule should improve cold, old, and pooled prediction over the strongest matched historical snapshot model, conventional softmax retrieval and fully fitted conventional regressors.

design.observations: 12 observed binary input dimensions, 9 true causal action bits, 3 context-sensitive nuisance cues; 3 hidden regimes with randomized 64–88 witness count each; transitions unmarked in learner input; stream chronological raw (x,y) only, independent random 9-bit assignments for training, calibration and held.
design.truth: Author-invented four signed hidden parity-of-two/three factors: 2 shared, 2 changed across contexts, including return-to-old, return-to-middle, and recomposition scenarios. Cues are intentionally correlated during training/query, independently random during held cold; observation noise normal(0,.16). Truth identity/coefficients used solely by evaluator/auditor.
design.observation_budget: Every learner receives the same entire chronological stream (3 stages, roughly 228 witnessed outcomes) and, per query, an additional 12 labeled calibration interventions; 64 disjoint held actions per requested hidden regime A/B/C; three query sessions have separate calibration sequences but no generated regime name given to learner.
design.leakage: Learners are not given A/B/C or changepoint index. The evaluator knows them for held-metric grouping; model fitting takes only x/y for stream/probe; held outcomes never used to select predictors. Query groups themselves reveal which samples belong to one calibration session and are not zero-shot.
design.candidate: One JSON persisted memory object containing overlapping OMP4 hypotheses trained from unlabeled stream windows of exactly 64 consecutive observations at stride16, plus final window. At query choose lowest calibration-MSE historical snapshot, with 50/50 consensus of best two iff at least 3/4 selected Walsh supports agree and second calibration MSE minus first <.04. No generator regime identifiers consulted.
design.grammar: Pre-supplied all pairwise/triple Walsh terms across all 12 bits (286 terms). This is finite authored grammar, not free discovery of causal operators.
controls: best_snapshot — same snapshots and calibration, select lowest MSE without consensus, strongest capacity-matched control
softmax_memory — conventional calibrated exponential weighting of every same-capacity snapshot temperature .10
last_snapshot — most recent historical snapshot without memory retrieval
pooled_elasticnet — supervised standard ElasticNet alpha .035 L1 .85 over all stream plus probe, fully fit
recent_elasticnet — standard ElasticNet same config on most recent 80 stream plus probe, fully fit
pooled_krr — standard RBF KernelRidge alpha .2 gamma .2 fully fit on all stream plus probe
random_snapshot — negative selected from persistent snapshot bank by fixed seed/world/family index
shuffled_probes — negative: use reverse-ordered query consequences for memory retrieval
design.compute: Single CPU Python3.13.5 NumPy2.3.5 sklearn1.8.0; OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1; one prospective 36-world primary, one unchanged-source semantic replay, independently written auditor re-fitting all 9 methods and snapshots. Preserve all original world/arm/prediction receipts. No cost/Joule claims.
design.metric: Unweighted per-world MSE on 64 held actions each of hidden regimes A, B, C, pooled across three; lower better. Report per-seed and family pooled means, matched best-snapshot errors, snapshot-state bytes, consensus decision fraction, selected snapshot indices and old-regime errors.

frozen_gates.cold_C_vs_matched_best_5pct: Aggregate C-context cold MSE of candidate <=0.95 * aggregate C-context MSE of capacity-matched best_snapshot.
frozen_gates.overall_vs_matched_best_5pct: Pooled A/B/C candidate MSE <=0.95*pooled best_snapshot MSE.
frozen_gates.overall_vs_strongest_other_5pct: Pooled candidate MSE <=0.95*minimum pooled MSE among best_snapshot,softmax_memory,last_snapshot,pooled_elasticnet,recent_elasticnet,pooled_krr.
frozen_gates.seed_stability_2of3: Candidate pooled MSE strictly less than best conventional pooled MSE (minimum among all six nonnegative controls) in at least 2 of the 3 preregistered seed cohorts.
frozen_gates.family_non_degradation_10pct: Candidate pooled MSE <=1.10*matched best_snapshot pooled MSE for every family.
frozen_gates.old_query_retention_vs_last_20pct: Candidate A historical held MSE <=.8*last_snapshot A held MSE.
frozen_gates.old_query_noninferiority_5pct: Candidate A historical held MSE <=1.05*best_snapshot A held MSE.
frozen_gates.serializer_refit_audit: Every world checkpoint JSON reserialized/read back, source-free independent refit all snapshot/control predictions and MSE within 1e-10; independently reconstruct keys and masks. No scorer import by auditor.
frozen_gates.consensus_exercised_10pct: At least 10% of 108 phase-query sessions use consensus rather than selecting one snapshot.

classify.DEVELOPMENT_PROVISIONAL_GO: All ten frozen gates PASS and independent refit/audit and semantic replay PASS. This is still external synthetic development, never SCIENTIFIC_PASS or native acceptance.
classify.DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO: Any frozen gate FAIL on valid primary evidence with complete auditable scores; preserve without posthoc modification or tuning.
classify.INVALID: Source/protocol absent before primary; source mismatch; leak of episode IDs, hidden truth or held labels into fitting; missing strong control; held assignment overlap; broken refit audit; incomplete original receipts.
classify.UNVERIFIED: Missing or incomplete primary or audit; do not label scientific.

protocol: No post-result hyperparameter, threshold, seed list, controller, runner, accepted-ref, promotion or deployment action; keep primary negative if no improvement. Preserve all original results in existing draft #1210.
history: Before source freeze, excluded seeds 998911 and 998921 were scored on 3 worlds each. Candidate vs matched best: 0.031196 vs 0.032461 and 0.029770 vs 0.028906 (mixed). Scorer changed only by deleting unused no-op loop before source commit. Primary seeds have not been evaluated.
